name: Pilot and ignition systems (pilots, igniters, flame scanners, BMS sequencing)
description: Provide a reliable ignition source for pilot and main burners and prove flame presence before fuel is admitted; burner management system (BMS) sequences purge, pilot trial-for-ignition, flame proof, main flame light-off and shutdown, while a separate combustion control system meters fuel/air. Flame scanners with background-flame discrimination allow light-off and verification from the control room.

specifications.basis: John Zink vendor page; stated faster than thermocouples which can take more than 9 minutes; control panel up to 1,000 ft from pilot; no compressed air required

specifications.metric: FFG remote ignition distance and service life
specifications.unit: ft (distance from pilot; 'over 1,000 feet'); >40 years proven performance
specifications.basis: John Zink vendor page; schedule 80 carbon or stainless steel piping; natural gas, propane, hydrogen; manual piezoelectric or automatic line-powered transformer
Zeeco Flame Scanners product page; ProFlame+ utility grade ZPF-1100UV/IR/DS, ZPF-1200UV/IR/DS, fiber optic ZPF-1200UF/IF
specifications.value: ZPF-110 (Zone 1, II 2G EExd IIC T6), ZPF-120 (Zone 2), ZPF-130 (nonhazardous)

specifications.unit: degrees C (50 F) below incoming compressed air
specifications.basis: Zeeco product page: vortex tube uses compressed air, no moving parts; cools scanner internals

specifications.metric: Zeeco Free Jet Power Burner emissions and turndown
specifications.unit: ppm NOx (9 ppm), sub-50 ppm CO, 20:1 fuel turndown; 30 ppm NOx potential without flue-gas recirculation
specifications.basis: Chemical Engineering magazine interview with Zeeco CTO; small external flue-gas recirculation

specifications.unit: ppm NOx across fuel compositions and furnace temperatures
specifications.basis: Chemical Engineering magazine; two combustion zones, compact flame length, designed to avoid SCR

specifications.unit: modules combinable from one user interface
specifications.basis: Chemical Engineering magazine; modules certified with regulatory bodies; can manage multiple burners or multiple pilots; forced-air I/O
